about_item: Dual Purpose Design: This outdoor adventure first aid kit is meticulously crafted to provide both human and canine first aid essentials, ensuring you're prepared for any trail mishaps
Comprehensive Guides: Equipped with a Pet First Aid manual and Wilderness & Travel Medicine Guide, this travel first aid kit offers reference for effective emergency response
Waterproof Storage: The Me & My Dog Medical Kit includes DryFlex waterproof bags, keeping your medical supplies dry and intact in various weather conditions
Emergency Equipment: Featuring an emergency cold pack and a SOL emergency blanket, the adventure dog medical kit is ready to assist in treating shock and injuries on the go
Practical Tools: With a 10 CC irrigation syringe and a splinter picker, this compact first aid kit aids in cleaning wounds and removing debris safely during your adventures

authors_reviews.title: Everything I need!
authors_reviews.text: I do a lot of outdoor activities and this first aid kit is perfect for my and my dog!! Compact, handy, things are in convenient pouches and ready to go. Glad to have it
authors_reviews.author: Sydni H.

authors_reviews.title: Perfect and reasonably sized
authors_reviews.text: We go camping with our dog all the time so I got this as a gift for my boyfriend since our set up was missing a First Aid Kit. I was really happy to find one that included things for the dog too! There is a website where you can reorder things you run out of. It has all the basic things you need and something you wouldn’t think of like an extra leash. Love it.
authors_reviews.author: Sydnee

authors_reviews.title: Great for basic first aid
authors_reviews.text: Got this because I hike a lot and camp occasionally with my dog. It comes with guides for quick reference if you’re far out and have spotty cell service, everything is packed well and it has some good stuff. Giving it 4 stars because my dog had a claw that was too short and bleeding, and I was SHOCKED this didn’t come with a quick stop product for bleeding. I feel like this is the most common first aid item for dogs. Seemed silly not to include it.
authors_reviews.author: Jasmine

authors_reviews.title: Perfect size and quite complete.
authors_reviews.text: As a dog boarder who takes her clients on hikes, this pack is exactly what I needed, small, easy to pack and will make any trip safer. The only thing I added to the pack was active charcoal (for those who eat things they shouldn't).
authors_reviews.author: JoJo

authors_reviews.title: All in One
authors_reviews.text: I liked this kit because it had a lot of important items that others did not (e.g. hydrogen peroxide) and I felt comfortable having everything I may need for a camping and kayaking trip, for me and my dog.
authors_reviews.author: justin thomsen

authors_reviews.title: Excellent
authors_reviews.text: One of the best value for money, first aid kit's for both animals and humans. I did add Pet Emergency Pocket Guide, 3M Vetrap Bandaging Tape, 5 yds Length x 4" Width, Blue, and a thermometer. I wish the bag was a tad bigger so I could add in a few missing things.
authors_reviews.author: phunkyvida
